title: StateSnapshot
description: Schema for an OS and browser state snapshot captured by the local agent or browser extension.

id.description: Unique identifier assigned by the database

active_app.description: Name of the currently focused application (e.g. Google Chrome, Visual Studio Code)

active_window_title.description: Title of the currently active window

browser_url.description: URL of the active browser tab if the active app is a browser

browser_tab_title.description: Title of the active browser tab if the active app is a browser

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this snapshot was captured

os_platform.description: OS platform name: darwin, win32, or linux
